Print Cost Calculator

Cost per page from cartridge price and yield plus paper cost.

–
Cost / mono page
–

–
Total print cost

For information only — not financial advice. Yields assume rated coverage; heavy graphics cost more.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your black cartridge price and its rated page yield.
  2. Optionally enter a color cartridge price and yield (leave 0 for mono only).
  3. Enter paper cost per ream and sheets per ream.
  4. Enter how many mono and color pages you print, and read the per-page and total costs.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does page yield mean?

The manufacturer's rated number of pages per cartridge, usually at 5% coverage. Real coverage varies, so treat this as a baseline.

Why add paper cost?

Paper is a real per-page cost: ream price divided by sheets per ream. It applies to both mono and color pages.

How is a color page costed?

Color page cost = color cartridge cost per page + paper cost. If you print mixed pages, enter the counts separately.
